profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ AVA Tech
profile.summary:
I am looking for a career that facilitates a workplace that will constantly challenge me to continue learning and experimenting with software development while also making use of my current technical skills listed below. It is important that my job gives me a goal to achieve rather than an obligation to put in my hours.

•	Languages: Java, C++, C, C#
•	Software Tools: Git, Eclipse
•	Applications: Adobe Photoshop, Microsoft Office (incl. Visio)
•	Operating Systems: Windows 7, Windows Vista, Linux/Unix
